Concomitant administration of clarithromycin with other drugs can lead to serious adverse reactions, including potentially fatal arrhythmias, and are contraindicated.

warfarin.t: Increased INR and prothrombin time in patients receiving PPIs, including rabeprazole, and warfarin concomitantly.
Dose adjustment of warfarin may be needed to maintain target INR range.

methotrexate.t: Concomitant use of rabeprazole with methotrexate (primarily at high dose) may elevate and prolong serum levels of methotrexate and/or its metabolite hydroxymethotrexate, possibly leading to methotrexate toxicities.
No formal drug interaction studies of methotrexate with PPIs have been conducted [see Warnings and Precautions ( 5.9 )].

digoxin.t: Potential for increased exposure of digoxin [see Clinical Pharmacology ( 12.3 )].
